course.title: NIRMAAN 2.0 BATCH Class 8th
course.description:
NIRMAAN 2.0 | Class 8 Foundation Program

NIRMAAN 2.0 is a comprehensive foundation program designed for Class 8 (CBSE) students to build strong conceptual clarity, excel in school academics, and strengthen their preparation for future competitive exams.

Key Features

✅ Live Interactive Classes (45 Minutes Each)
✅ 24×7 Access to Recorded Lectures on App & Web
✅ Complete Coverage of New  NCERT ( Live ) & Old NCERT Curriculum ( Rec.)
* Science, Mathematics, Social Science , English,  Hindi & Sanskrit 

✅ Dedicated English Speaking Course for Fluent Communication
✅ Classroom Notes & Handwritten Notes by Teachers
✅ NCERT Experiment Videos 
✅ Chapter-wise  Tests & NIRMAAN Question Bank
✅ Detailed Performance Analysis & Test Reports
✅ Dedicated Doubt Classes After Every Chapter
✅ Weekly Study Timetable 
✅ Chapter-wise PDF Notes Available on App & Web After Every Class

*Special Benefits*
*FREE English Speaking Program *FREE Nirmaan 1.0 Access *FREE Crash Course

Batch Timeline

*Batch Starts: July 2026
*Syllabus Completion* :November 2026
*Course Access Valid Till Final Exams

⸻
